queries.name: snapshot_conteos
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS tabla, SUM(p.rows) AS filas FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name IN ('Comercial_RecetasSnapshot','Comercial_RecetasSnapshotDetalle') AND p.index_id IN (0,1) GROUP BY t.name

queries.name: snapshot_columnas
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS tabla, c.name AS columna, ty.name AS tipo FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name IN ('Comercial_RecetasSnapshot','Comercial_RecetasSnapshotDetalle') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

objective: Gate R4: comprobar en SQL Server EDARSAHUB la existencia, estructura y conteos de las tablas historicas de recetas. Determinar si hay datos reales para fotografias mensuales. No modificar datos, codigo, Scheduler ni Produccion.
